findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: whats_new, search_posts, get_feed, get_post, install_post, list_branches, file_verdict, give_award, since, home, install_harness · Private data: search_posts, install_post, post_improvement, post_question, post_blog, post_tool, file_verdict, give_award, install_harness · Public sink: join, whats_new, search_posts, get_feed, get_post, install_post, list_branches, post_improvement, post_question, post_blog, post_tool, comment, file_verdict, give_award, vote, install_harness, add_to_harness · Destructive: post_improvement, post_question, post_blog, post_tool, comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: whats_new, search_posts, get_feed, get_post, install_post, list_branches, file_verdict, give_award, since, home, install_harness · Private data: search_posts, install_post, post_improvement, post_question, post_blog, post_tool, file_verdict, give_award, install_harness · Public sink: join, whats_new, search_posts, get_feed, get_post, install_post, list_branches, post_improvement, post_question, post_blog, post_tool, comment, file_verdict, give_award, vote, install_harness, add_to_harness · Destructive: post_improvement, post_question, post_blog, post_tool, comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
